question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    week_date,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    AND (
      (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-05-21', '2018-05-28', '2018-06-04', '2018-06-11', '2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-02', '2018-07-09'))
      OR
      (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10', '2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08'))
      OR
      (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-05-11', '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13'))
    )
  GROUP BY calendar_year, week_date
),
period_sales AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    SUM(total_sales) AS period_total,
    CASE
      WHEN week_date IN ('2018-05-21', '2018-05-28', '2018-06-04', '2018-06-11') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2020-05-11', '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-02', '2018-07-09') THEN 'post'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08') THEN 'post'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13') THEN 'post'
    END AS period
  FROM weekly_totals
  GROUP BY calendar_year,
    CASE
      WHEN week_date IN ('2018-05-21', '2018-05-28', '2018-06-04', '2018-06-11') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2020-05-11', '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-02', '2018-07-09') THEN 'post'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08') THEN 'post'
      WHEN week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13') THEN 'post'
    END
),
pivot_result AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN period_total END) AS pre_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN period_total END) AS post_total
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  pre_total,
  post_total,
  ROUND(1.0 * (post_total - pre_total) / pre_total * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM pivot_result
ORDER BY calendar_year
